observations.detail: The authenticated organization and workspace selector rendered.
RecyclerOS Operations was available for Effortless Smoke, LLC with the Operator role and opened successfully.
Mission Control rendered tenant-scoped zero-state opportunity, pick-list, and inventory metrics.
Opportunity Discovery opened and rendered the new-opportunity form, disabled pre-validation action, and empty active-opportunities state.
After signing in again on the session-guard build, the tester created synthetic opportunity OPP-000002 with a blank VIN. The active-opportunity card and enabled Create Vehicle Record action rendered.

The live workflow created vehicle VEH-000002 from opportunity OPP-000002. The Vehicle Record rendered the synthetic year, make, and model; VIN Pending; mileage 126000; discovered lifecycle; part out intent; and linked timeline.
For later synthetic opportunity OPP-000003, Procurement rendered Resale, Personal Use, and Part-Out scenarios. Part-Out was recommended at a $3900 max bid, $3250 projected net, and 81% confidence.
Approving Part-Out created one queued synthetic vehicle at Greenville Pull-A-Part, Row 12. Open Focus Point was disabled before availability selection and enabled after Available was selected.
Focus Point opened with an active KPI timer, confirmed yard and row, five available-part checkboxes, and completion disabled until parts are selected.
Selecting ECM / PCM and LED Headlights enabled Complete Focus Point. Completion succeeded and navigated to Inventory Intake.
Inventory Intake rendered with ECM / PCM, storage location A-12, condition Used Untested, status Available, zero session items, and Create Inventory enabled.
Create Inventory saved ECM / PCM as INV-000002. The ready-for-sync confirmation, one-item session count, and Session Inventory entry rendered.

continuity_note.detail: Opportunity and Vehicle Record evidence used OPP-000002 and VEH-000002. Procurement evidence shows a later synthetic opportunity OPP-000003. These screenshots prove manual stage behavior through Focus Point entry but do not prove one uninterrupted entity chain across every retained screenshot.

observed_defects.detail: After browser session state was lost, Opportunity Discovery rendered with write actions disabled instead of returning to sign-in.
observed_defects.resolution: PR 26 added authentication and workspace route guards. CI run 33020582147 and Pages deployment 33061203825 passed, and the iPhone retest created OPP-000002 with synthetic data.
observed_defects.sensitive_reproduction_evidence_note: The original reproduction screenshot was not retained because it may contain a real VIN.

observed_defects.detail: The Flutter client has no logout control and Rc1Gateway has no logout operation, so a field operator cannot revoke the bearer session from the UI.
observed_defects.evidence_note: Repository code inspection and the completed iPhone path through Inventory Intake establish the missing final action.
